description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingDefinitionNotModifiableException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project to signal that a certain 'thing' definition cannot be modified, typically due to insufficient permissions. It includes builder pattern implementations, static factory methods for JSON parsing, and metadata annotations.
